global: Cinematic still, photorealistic, 35mm film, shallow depth of field, warm neutral grade, natural light, subtle grain, warm skin with a hint of cool blue in the shadows. Subject in the right half of the frame, the left third open and calm for type. The person does not look at the camera. No screen facing the camera. Absolutely no text, letters, numbers, logos, wordmarks, signage, livery, airline branding, seat-back branding, menus, boarding passes or departure boards anywhere in the frame. Bags and clothing have no visible logos or hardware lettering.
premium: Premium cabin feels like a current US carrier's first or business class: enclosed suite with sliding door, high walls, navy or charcoal leather, warm amber reading light, wood or brushed metal trim. Any aircraft is plain white, no livery, partly out of focus. Cast is young, successful, busy, elegant and quietly sexy: tailoring, silk, bare skin only at collar or shoulder, caught mid-moment, never posed.

scenes.ny28-lounge: A woman about 30, mixed ethnicity, in a cream cashmere coat over a fitted black knit dress, low sleek bun, gold hoops, stands at a floor-to-ceiling window in a quiet New York airport lounge at dawn holding an espresso, looking out at planes on the tarmac; a tan structured top-handle leather bag rests on the chair beside her.
scenes.ny29-firstclass: A man about 33, mixed ethnicity, navy unstructured blazer over a white tee, slim silver watch, relaxed half smile, sits in a private first class suite at night, looking out of the window at the lights of Manhattan far below; a glass of champagne untouched on the side ledge.
scenes.atl24-lounge: A Black woman about 29 in an ivory silk shirt open at the collar and camel wide-leg trousers, heels, long legs crossed, sunglasses pushed up into her hair, sits in a leather lounge chair at a tall window at sunset in an Atlanta airport lounge, runway and a plain white jet glowing beyond; a black structured top-handle bag beside her; she is reading something on her phone held low, smiling slightly.
scenes.atl25-privateterminal: A man about 34, mixed ethnicity, in a cream linen suit, shirt open at the neck, walks across a private-aviation tarmac at blue hour toward a small plain white business jet with its stairs down, a leather weekender in one hand, jacket moving in the wind; Atlanta skyline faint on the horizon.
scenes.la24-terrace: A woman about 32, mixed ethnicity, with sun-streaked hair, white oversized blazer over a champagne silk slip dress, shoulders bare under the open blazer, stands on a sunlit Los Angeles airport lounge terrace with palms, holding sunglasses, looking off to the side, a plain white jet parked beyond in hard golden afternoon sun.
scenes.la25-overnight: An East Asian American woman about 27, a founder, reclines in a lie-flat business class suite at night, cashmere wrap slipping off one shoulder, silk eye mask pushed up into her hair, quiet smile toward the dark window, amber reading light.
